name: Hoshino Nagisa
source: Childhood friend of [url=/c22452]Komatsu Rina[/url] and [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url], but due to an incident in the past, she has been distant from [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url] for several years. A member of the track and field club, she participates in the 3000m event. She trains vigorously every day.
translation: [url=/c22452]小松里奈[/url]和[url=/c22455]关谷明人[/url]的青梅竹马，但由于过去的一起事件，她与[url=/c22455]关谷明人[/url]疏远了数年。她是田径部成员，参加3000米项目，每天都刻苦训练。
